testFeaturesSettings.name: Test Features
testFeaturesSettings.label: Configure Test Features
testFeaturesSettings.hint: Experimental features currently under active development.

testFeaturesEnabled.name: Test Features
testFeaturesEnabled.hint: Enables experimental features currently under development. Turn this off to disable all test features at once.

ironSaintRegionEffect.name: Iron Saint Region Effect
ironSaintRegionEffect.hint: Applies a specific active effect to hostile tokens inside regions named 'The Iron Saint Does Not Recognize Retreat', and removes it when they leave all such regions.

letheWindedEffect.name: Lethe Winded Effect
letheWindedEffect.hint: Applies two specific active effects to any token with the Lethe feature while winded, and removes them when they recover above half stamina.

encroachingHorde.name: Encroaching Horde
encroachingHorde.hint: A region named 'Encroaching Horde' activates at round 2 and advances one square right after each turn, reducing any heroes it overtakes to 0 stamina.

installMacros.name: Install API Macros
installMacros.label: Install Macros
installMacros.hint: Creates a folder of ready-to-use macros for every module API function in your Macros sidebar.

enhancedPromptMode.name: Enhanced Abilities Prompt
enhancedPromptMode.hint: When to offer adding the Enhanced Abilities compendium (Hide, Search, and more to come) to every actor in the world.

onlineNoticeCheck.name: Check Online for Module News
onlineNoticeCheck.hint: Ask the Combat Tools page for its list of recommended modules each time the world opens, so new ones and new versions can be mentioned without waiting for an update here. Switch it off to use the list this copy came with and never reach out.

enhancedAutoAdd.name: Keep Enhanced Abilities Current
enhancedAutoAdd.hint: On every load, and for every actor created, adds the Enhanced Abilities an actor is missing and brings older copies up to date. Answering the prompt sets this; switch it off here.

completeEncounterMode.name: Complete Encounter Window
completeEncounterMode.hint: The system asks about victories and resets whenever a combat ends. Accepting answers it with its defaults (1 victory, temporary Stamina, heroic resources and surges reset) without showing it; skipping closes it and applies nothing.

choice.accept: Accept the defaults without showing it

enhancedSwapMode.name: Overwrite On Import
enhancedSwapMode.hint: What to do when you import something the Combat Tools compendiums carry an enhanced version of. Asking lists what would be overwritten before anything is written.

distributeEnhanced.name: Add Enhanced Abilities
distributeEnhanced.label: Add to Every Actor
distributeEnhanced.hint: Adds every ability from the DSCT: Enhanced Abilities compendium to every actor in the world that does not already have it. Hide and Search gather the scattered stealth rules into one action each.

macroPromptMode.name: Sample Macro Import Prompt
macroPromptMode.hint: When to offer the Director the sample macros on load.

choice.skipUpdate: Ask only when the module updates

dstdQuickFmButton.name: Quick Forced Movement Button
dstdQuickFmButton.hint: With more than one target, add a small forced movement button to the collapsed target header, beside the damage button. The damage button shrinks to an icon and a number to make room.

playerCanUndoCausedDeaths.name: Players Can Undo Deaths Their Owned Actors Caused
playerCanUndoCausedDeaths.hint: Players can undo a death they caused, from the chat message that reports it. Deaths dealt from a damage card are undone on the card itself.

squadTargetingIcon.name: Squad Targeting Icon
squadTargetingIcon.hint: Icon shown on each minion while the squad’s targets are being picked.

minionHealthEstimate.name: Minion Health Estimate Display
minionHealthEstimate.hint: What Health Estimate shows for minions in a squad during an encounter. Minions with no squad, or outside an encounter, are unaffected.

forcedMovementEnabled.name: Forced Movement
forcedMovementEnabled.hint: Resolve forced movement for you: the panel for setting up a push, slide or pull, and the chat messages that report what happened.

forcedMovementSettings.name: Forced Movement Settings
forcedMovementSettings.label: Configure Forced Movement
forcedMovementSettings.hint: Animation speed, the prompts before a fall or before hitting an ally, and who may change a move afterwards.

animationStepDelay.name: Animation Step Delay (ms)
animationStepDelay.hint: How long a forced move pauses on each square it crosses. Set it to 0 for no animation.

fallDamageCap.name: Fall Damage Cap
fallDamageCap.hint: The most damage one fall can deal, however far the drop.

fallConfirmation.name: Fall Confirmation
fallConfirmation.hint: Ask in chat before resolving a fall, rather than dropping the creature straight away.

friendlyFireConfirmation.name: Friendly Fire Confirmation
friendlyFireConfirmation.hint: Ask in chat when a forced move would send an ally into something and hurt them.

ignoreAllyEnabled.name: Allow Allies to Dodge
ignoreAllyEnabled.hint: Allow smaller allies to get out of the way of big enemies using a chat confirmation prompt. Requires Friendly Fire Confirmation.

corpsesBlock.name: Corpses Block Movement
corpsesBlock.hint: Creatures that have fallen still block forced movement, and cannot be shifted out of the way.

negativeElevationIsBurrowing.name: Below the Ground Counts as Burrowing
negativeElevationIsBurrowing.hint: A creature at a negative elevation cannot be moved by force, since it counts as burrowing. Turn this off on maps whose ground goes below elevation 0. A creature with the Burrow status is still safe either way.

statusDrivesMovementType.name: Burrow and Fly Statuses Decide
statusDrivesMovementType.hint: The Burrow and Fly statuses settle how a creature is moved, whatever its elevation: a burrowing creature cannot be moved by force at all, and a flying one is always moved up or down rather than across.

fmModifyGmOnly.name: Restrict Modify Button to Director
fmModifyGmOnly.hint: Only the Director sees the pencil for changing a forced move after the fact. Turn it off to let players use it too.

grabEnabled.name: Grab
grabEnabled.hint: A grabbed creature takes a bane on abilities that do not target whoever holds it, and is dragged along when they move. Grabs can be ended from the Grab panel.

grabbedEffectIcon.name: Grabbed Effect Icon
grabbedEffectIcon.hint: The image used for the creature being held.

grabberEffectIcon.name: Grabber Effect Icon
grabberEffectIcon.hint: The image used for the one holding them.

gmBypassesSizeCheck.name: Director Bypasses Size Check
gmBypassesSizeCheck.hint: The Director can grab or knock back a creature of any size, ignoring the size limit.

restrictGrabButtons.name: Restrict Automatic Grab Buttons to Director
restrictGrabButtons.hint: Only the Director sees the buttons that apply or end a grab outright, with nobody rolling for it.

allowIllegalMovement.name: Allow Illegal Movement
allowIllegalMovement.hint: Let a creature move anyway when a condition should stop it, warning you instead of blocking the move.

conditionsEnabled.name: Conditions
conditionsEnabled.hint: Handle frightened, taunted, bleeding, grabs and area damage for you. Turn this off and none of the settings below do anything.

frightenedEnabled.name: Frightened
frightenedEnabled.hint: A frightened creature takes a bane against whatever frightens it, gives that creature an edge in return, and cannot willingly move closer to it.

appliedEffectEnabled.name: Effect Buttons Follow Your Target
appliedEffectEnabled.hint: Effect buttons in chat apply to the creature you have targeted rather than the one you have selected, and players can use them on creatures they do not own while the Director is online.

applyDamageEnabled.name: Damage Buttons Follow Your Target
applyDamageEnabled.hint: Damage buttons in chat apply to the creatures you have targeted rather than the ones you have selected, and players can use them on creatures they do not own while the Director is online.

tauntedEnabled.name: Taunted
tauntedEnabled.hint: A taunted creature takes a double bane on any ability that does not target whoever taunted it, as long as it can still see them.

conditionsSettings.name: Conditions & Damage
conditionsSettings.label: Configure Conditions & Damage
conditionsSettings.hint: Frightened, taunted, bleeding, grabs, and damage that hits an area.

areaDamageEnabled.name: Area Damage Automation
areaDamageEnabled.hint: Name the damage buttons on area abilities, and stop a minion in a squad losing more Stamina to one area than it has.

bleedingEnabled.name: Bleeding
bleedingEnabled.hint: A bleeding creature loses 1d6 + their level Stamina whenever they use a main action, use a triggered action, or make a test or ability roll using Might or Agility. Once per action.

bleedingMode.name: Bleeding Automation Mode
bleedingMode.hint: Whether that Stamina loss is applied for you, with an undo, or just rolled for you to apply yourself.

deathTrackerEnabled.name: Death Tracker
deathTrackerEnabled.hint: A defeated creature leaves the Combat Tracker but stays where it fell, red and faded, and can still be moved by forced movement. Deaths are announced in chat.

deathTrackerManualMode.name: Manual Mode
deathTrackerManualMode.hint: Step through every death and revival in chat, approving or undoing each stage. For testing, not for play.

deathTrackerSettings.name: Death Tracker Settings
deathTrackerSettings.label: Configure Death Tracker
deathTrackerSettings.hint: The death animation, clearing the fallen when an encounter ends, what a revival brings back, and how minion deaths are decided.

deathAnimationDuration.name: Death Animation Duration (ms)
deathAnimationDuration.hint: How long a creature takes to fade out as it falls. Set it to 0 to skip.

batchAnimationSafety.name: Skip Animation on Mass Kill
batchAnimationSafety.hint: Skip the fade when eight or more creatures fall at once, to keep things smooth.

clearSkullsOnCombatEnd.name: Clear Defeated Tokens at Combat End
clearSkullsOnCombatEnd.hint: Clear the fallen off the map when the encounter ends.

clearEffectsOnRevive.name: Clear Effects on Revive
clearEffectsOnRevive.hint: A revived creature comes back free of its conditions and effects.

autoAssignDamagedMinion.name: Auto-Assign Damaged Minion on Death
autoAssignDamagedMinion.hint: When a squad loses only part of its Stamina, the minions that were hit are the ones that die. Turn it off to decide those yourself; a whole squad going down is still handled for you.

pickDeathsEnabled.name: Pick Ambiguous Deaths
pickDeathsEnabled.hint: Ask who dies when it is not clear, by picking minions on the map. Whoever dealt the damage chooses. Turn it off and the deaths are assigned for you.

deathPickerDimAll.name: Dim Highlight All Candidates
deathPickerDimAll.hint: Faintly mark every minion you could pick, so the choices are easy to see. Turn it off for a cleaner map.

gmControlsAllDeathPickers.name: Director Controls All Death Picks
gmControlsAllDeathPickers.hint: The Director always chooses who dies, even when a player dealt the damage.

cedeDeathPickerToGM.name: Let Director Pick Deaths
cedeDeathPickerToGM.hint: Let the Director choose who dies instead of you.

overrideMinionDefeat.name: Alternative Minion Defeat UI
overrideMinionDefeat.hint: Let this module work out which minions die, instead of the system asking you.

cleanOrphanedCombatants.name: Clean Up Orphaned Combat Tracker Entries
cleanOrphanedCombatants.hint: Tidy away Combat Tracker entries for creatures that are no longer there, and keep a squad’s Stamina in step as its minions die. Best left on.

deathMarkerEnabled.name: Show Death Marker
deathMarkerEnabled.hint: Mark the spot where a creature fell. The mark follows if it is moved, and goes when it is revived.

deathMarkerIcon.name: Death Marker Icon
deathMarkerIcon.hint: The image used to mark where a creature fell.

squadToolsSettings.name: Squad Tools Settings
squadToolsSettings.label: Configure Squad Tools
squadToolsSettings.hint: Configure squad labels, simultaneous turns, and the squad HUD.

squadToolsEnabled.name: Squad Tools
squadToolsEnabled.hint: Squad labels, turns taken together, the squad bar and squad targeting. Turn this off and none of the settings below do anything.

autoSquadLabelsEnabled.name: Squad Labels
autoSquadLabelsEnabled.hint: At the start of combat, offer to number each minion squad and show that number on every minion token, with its own icon for the captain.

squadGlowMarker.name: Subtle Turn Markers
squadGlowMarker.hint: Replace the turn marker under whoever is acting with a soft pulsing glow.

squadGlowMarkerColored.name: Colored Glow
squadGlowMarkerColored.hint: Tint the glow to match the token: a player’s own colour, or a numbered squad’s colour.

squadLabelApplyEffects.name: Show Labels on Tokens
squadLabelApplyEffects.hint: Put the labels on the tokens for you. With this off, squads are still renamed at the start of combat and the Squad Labels macro adds the labels when you want them.

squadLabelAutoRelabel.name: Renumber After Losses
squadLabelAutoRelabel.hint: When a squad is gone, renumber the squads that are left so there are no gaps in the numbering, and free its captain of a squad they no longer have.

squadLabelCaptainNow.name: I Am The Captain Now
squadLabelCaptainNow.hint: Ask the Director to pick a captain for any minion squad without one, at the start of combat and at the start of each round.

squadCaptainShortcut.name: Skip the Captain Picker When Obvious
squadCaptainShortcut.hint: When there are exactly as many candidates as there are squads needing a captain, hand them out without asking.

squadLabelRenamePreference.name: Auto-Rename Preference
squadLabelRenamePreference.hint: Whether to ask before renaming squads at the start of combat, or always do the same thing.

squadSimultaneousTurns.name: Squads Take Their Turn Together
squadSimultaneousTurns.hint: A minion squad acts all at once: every minion takes the same turn, start of turn effects fire for all of them, and the turn marker sits under each one.

pairSimultaneousTurns.name: Mentor Pairs Take Their Turn Together
pairSimultaneousTurns.hint: A hero and their retainer or companion act on the same turn without being put in a group. Start and end of turn effects fire for both, and the turn marker sits under both.

squadHudEnabled.name: Squad HUD
squadHudEnabled.hint: One floating bar for each minion squad, instead of a Stamina bar on every minion. It shows the squad name, a segment for each minion still standing, and the squad’s Stamina. Hovering a minion or the bar draws lines to the rest of the squad.

squadHudScale.name: Squad HUD Size
squadHudScale.hint: How big the floating squad bar is. Everyone sets their own. It already scales with the scene grid, so small changes go a long way.

squadHudPlayerVisibility.name: Squad HUD Player Visibility
squadHudPlayerVisibility.hint: How much of the squad bar players see. The Director always sees all of it.

stickbugMode.name: Get Stick Bugged
stickbugMode.hint: Teaches the squad health bars a new skill.

stickbugChatTrigger.name: Chat Trigger: Get Stick Bugged
stickbugChatTrigger.hint: Does something when you get stick bugged in chat.

autoTriggeredActionsEnabled.name: Triggered Action Tracker
autoTriggeredActionsEnabled.hint: Mark combatants with an Unspent Triggered Action when combat starts, take the mark away when they use a triggered action, and give it back at the start of each round.

triggeredActionsSettings.name: Triggered Actions Settings
triggeredActionsSettings.label: Configure Triggered Actions
triggeredActionsSettings.hint: Choose which combatants receive the tracker and whether to require a triggered ability on their sheet.

autoTriggeredActionsTarget.name: Triggered Action Tracker Targets
autoTriggeredActionsTarget.hint: Who is marked when combat starts.

triggeredActionsRequireAbility.name: Only Track Combatants With Triggered Abilities
triggeredActionsRequireAbility.hint: Only mark a creature that actually has a triggered ability on its sheet.

teleportEnabled.name: Teleport Tool
teleportEnabled.hint: Teleporting a controlled token across the map: the toolbar button, and a Teleport button on any ability that teleports.

abilityAutomationSettings.name: Ability Automation Settings
abilityAutomationSettings.label: Configure Ability Automation
abilityAutomationSettings.hint: Configure class ability automations for Censor, Tactician, and Shadow, plus ability range enforcement and malice features.

flatEffectsSettings.name: Flat Effects Settings
flatEffectsSettings.label: Configure Flat Effects
flatEffectsSettings.hint: Enable or disable flat special effects and set the default values new flat effects are created with.

flatEffectsEnabled.name: Flat Effects
flatEffectsEnabled.hint: Effects on an ability that happen however the power roll turns out. Turn this off and none of the settings below do anything, and no flat effect buttons appear in chat. Anything already set up on an ability is left untouched.

flatDefaultSpendEnabled.name: Spend Resource On By Default
flatDefaultSpendEnabled.hint: A new flat effect starts with Spend Resource already ticked.

flatDefaultSpendValue.name: Default Spend Cost
flatDefaultSpendValue.hint: What a new flat effect costs to use, when Spend Resource is ticked.

flatDefaultDamageFormula.name: Default Damage Formula
flatDefaultDamageFormula.hint: The damage a new flat damage effect starts with.

flatDefaultDamageType.name: Default Damage Type
flatDefaultDamageType.hint: The damage type a new flat damage effect starts with.

flatDefaultMovement.name: Default Movement Type
flatDefaultMovement.hint: Whether a new flat forced movement effect starts as a push, a pull or a slide.

flatDefaultForcedDistance.name: Default Distance
flatDefaultForcedDistance.hint: How many squares a new flat forced movement effect starts out moving a creature.

flatDefaultPotencyStrength.name: Default Potency Strength
flatDefaultPotencyStrength.hint: The potency a new flat condition effect starts at.

flatDefaultAppliedEnd.name: Default End Condition
flatDefaultAppliedEnd.hint: When a condition from a new flat effect ends: the end of a turn, a save, or the end of the encounter.

flatDefaultResourceType.name: Default Resource Type
flatDefaultResourceType.hint: Which resource a new flat resource effect gives, a Surge for instance.

flatDefaultResourceAmount.name: Default Resource Amount
flatDefaultResourceAmount.hint: How much of it a new flat resource effect gives.

flatDefaultHealAmountType.name: Default Heal Amount Type
flatDefaultHealAmountType.hint: Whether a new flat heal effect starts from the target’s recovery value or from a formula you write.

flatDefaultHealTempStamina.name: Temporary Stamina By Default
flatDefaultHealTempStamina.hint: A new flat heal effect starts out granting temporary Stamina instead of healing.

flatDefaultCleanseRepeatable.name: Repeatable Cleanse By Default
flatDefaultCleanseRepeatable.hint: A new flat cleanse effect starts with Repeatable already ticked.

abilityAutomationEnabled.name: Ability Automation
abilityAutomationEnabled.hint: Help with abilities: picking targets, checking distance, class features and their reminders. Turn this off and none of the settings below do anything.

abilityTargetingEnabled.name: Ability Targeting
abilityTargetingEnabled.hint: Ask you to pick an ability’s targets on the map before the roll window opens. Turn it off if you would rather target by hand first.

groupActionsEnabled.name: Group Actions
groupActionsEnabled.hint: When a minion uses a signature ability, choose a target for every minion in the squad that can reach one, and roll the squad’s ability against all of them at once.

judgementAutomation.name: Judgement
judgementAutomation.hint: Adds a button to the Judgement chat card to judge your target, then follows the judged creature: a reminder in chat each time Judgement can be used, and a prompt to judge someone new when the judged creature falls.

judgedEffectIcon.name: Judged Effect Icon
judgedEffectIcon.hint: Icon shown on a judged creature.

judgementBaneLock.name: Hold the Roll for the Censor
judgementBaneLock.hint: When a judged creature makes a power roll, its roll buttons are held briefly so the Censor has time to impose the bane or decline.

judgementBaneLockDuration.name: Seconds to Hold the Roll
judgementBaneLockDuration.hint: How long the roll is held when a Judgement bane reminder is posted.

markAutomation.name: Mark
markAutomation.hint: Adds an Apply Mark button to every chat card that can mark, and prompts the Tactician to mark someone new within 10 squares when the marked creature falls. Knows which marks replace an earlier one and which do not.

markedEffectIcon.name: Marked Effect Icon
markedEffectIcon.hint: Icon shown on a marked creature.

aidAttackAutomation.name: Aid Attack
aidAttackAutomation.hint: Adds an Aid Attack button to the Aid Attack chat card. It marks the enemy you targeted so the next ally ability roll against them has an edge, and clears the mark once someone rolls against them or combat ends.

aidAttackEffectIcon.name: Aid Attack Effect Icon
aidAttackEffectIcon.hint: Icon shown on a creature that has been aided.

imNoThreatEnabled.name: I'm No Threat
imNoThreatEnabled.hint: Adds a button to the I'm No Threat chat card for choosing what the illusion looks like. The token takes that look until the Shadow makes a strike.

imNoThreatEffectIcon.name: I'm No Threat Effect Icon
imNoThreatEffectIcon.hint: Icon shown on a creature hidden behind an I'm No Threat illusion.

abyssalEvolutionEnabled.name: Abyssal Evolution
abyssalEvolutionEnabled.hint: Adds a button to the Abyssal Evolution chat card for turning an abyssal minion into a horde creature of the same level.

squadAutoAssignStaminaPriority.name: Auto-Assign Stamina Priority
squadAutoAssignStaminaPriority.hint: Which enemies take the extra free strikes when a squad has more minions than enemies. Every enemy is covered by one minion first.

crossfadeEnabled.name: Crossfade
crossfadeEnabled.hint: Adds the edge to a power roll when Crossfade applies, and posts a Disengage reminder in chat. Homebrew from SurfingBird’s (bendking) Shadow Reshade.

nullGrabIntuition.name: Psionic Martial Arts Size Check
nullGrabIntuition.hint: A hero with Psionic Martial Arts uses Intuition instead of Might to work out whether they can grab a creature bigger than they are. Needs Conditions turned on.

psionicMartialArts.name: No Speed Penalty While Grabbing
psionicMartialArts.hint: A hero with Psionic Martial Arts keeps their full speed while grabbing a creature their own size or larger. Homebrew from Matte’s Null Unbroken.

hiwEnabled.name: Hesitation Is Weakness
hiwEnabled.hint: Posts a chat notice with a Start Turn button when another hero’s turn ends and Hesitation Is Weakness can be used. Steps aside while Draw Steel: Triggers is handling turn changes.

purifyingFireEnabled.name: Purifying Fire
purifyingFireEnabled.hint: Adds an Apply Fire Damage button beside holy damage when the acting hero has Purifying Fire, so the damage can be dealt as fire and set off a target’s weakness to it.

neutralizeEnrichers.name: Replace Apply Links in Ability Text
neutralizeEnrichers.hint: Turn the apply links written into an ability’s description into plain text, and offer this module’s own buttons instead.

alwaysRepickTargets.name: Always Re-Pick Targets
alwaysRepickTargets.hint: Clear whatever you had targeted before an ability resolves, so you are always asked to pick again.

autoConfirmSelection.name: Auto-Confirm Target Selection
autoConfirmSelection.hint: Confirm as soon as you have picked as many targets as the ability allows, with no need to press Enter. When there are no more valid targets than it allows, they are picked for you.

rollDialogPillUI.name: Alternative Ability Roll UI
rollDialogPillUI.hint: A different roll window that lists every bane and edge by name, and often where it came from. It also offers the situational banes and edges the rules describe but nothing tracks for you, ready to tick on.

dstdSquadSections.name: Group Squads in Damage Panels
dstdSquadSections.hint: Folds a damage panel's target rows into a collapsible section per squad, so a card that hits a whole minion squad reads as one line instead of eight. Targets outside a squad are left where they are.

dstdSquadSectionsOpen.name: Open Squad Sections by Default
dstdSquadSectionsOpen.hint: Squad sections start open rather than collapsed. Whichever way a section is left is remembered on this device for that message.

dstdRollPills.name: Power Roll Modifiers in Chat
dstdRollPills.hint: Lists each target’s banes and edges by name under the roll result in chat. Rolls made in the Alternative Ability Roll UI keep their names and sources, and a later edit to a roll is listed too and can be taken off again.

dstdRollEditor.name: Modifier Roll Editor
dstdRollEditor.hint: Replaces the edit roll window on an ability in chat with a compact editor in the Alternative Ability Roll UI style. What you add there is listed under the roll and can be taken off again.

pillDamageEditor.name: Modifier Damage Editor
pillDamageEditor.hint: Replaces the edit damage window on an ability in chat with an editor in the Alternative Ability Roll UI style, covering spent Surges, a change of damage type, and named changes listed under the damage button.

skipPillEditor.name: Cog Opens Add Modifier Directly
skipPillEditor.hint: The cog on a damage or power roll row goes straight to adding one modifier, instead of opening the editor first. Hold Shift while clicking it for the full editor.

multiplierOverride.name: Damage Multiplier Override
multiplierOverride.hint: Half and Double damage always apply last, after bonuses, penalties and Surges, whatever order they were added in.

noMultiplierStacking.name: No Multiplier Stacking
noMultiplierStacking.hint: A second Half, or a second Double, has no effect and shows dimmed.

highGroundEnabled.name: High Ground Edge
highGroundEnabled.hint: Offer the High Ground edge when the attacker is standing higher than the target.

coverBaneEnabled.name: Cover Bane
coverBaneEnabled.hint: Shows a Cover bane in the roll dialog for damage dealing abilities when no corner of your space can see more than two corners of the target's.

abilityTemplateConfigEnabled.name: Configure Ability Templates
abilityTemplateConfigEnabled.hint: Adds a Configure Template button to any ability with an area, where its colour, visibility, highlighting and region behaviours are set once and reused every time that ability places its area. Players can set up their own abilities without the Director.

abilityTemplateCleanup.name: Clear Placed Areas
abilityTemplateCleanup.hint: Clear an ability’s area off the map once it has stopped mattering. An area goes at the end of the turn, or after the time set below, whichever comes first. Abilities marked Ongoing keep theirs until the moment chosen for them.

abilityTemplateSeconds.name: Seconds Before Clearing
abilityTemplateSeconds.hint: How long a placed area stays before it is cleared, when the ability is not marked Ongoing. The end of the turn still clears it sooner.

concealmentBlur.name: Blur Concealed Creatures
concealmentBlur.hint: Blurs the artwork of a concealed creature, leaving its bars and name readable. Changes only your own screen, and 0 turns it off.

lowCoverEnabled.name: Low Cover
lowCoverEnabled.hint: Lets low walls, furniture and objects give cover without blocking line of effect, the way a wall you can shoot over does. Adds a Low Cover Wall tool, a tickbox on every wall, and a cover setting on creature and object sheets.

observationRadius.name: Unobserved Ground Shown
observationRadius.hint: How far around a hiding creature the observation picker looks when showing ground an enemy cannot watch. Context only, and larger numbers cost more on a walled map.

observationAdjacentThreshold.name: Unobserved Squares to Suggest Hiding
observationAdjacentThreshold.hint: When more than this many squares next to a creature are out of an enemy's view, the picker suggests that enemy is not observing them. Set to 0 for any unwatched square to count.

enforceAbilityRange.name: Enforce Ability Range
enforceAbilityRange.hint: Only let an ability, a grab or forced movement reach as far as its distance allows. With this off, a target out of range can still be chosen.

suppressTrackerAutoDefeat.name: Own Death Instead of the Combat Tracker
suppressTrackerAutoDefeat.hint: Let this module decide when a creature dies, rather than the Combat Tracker calling it dead the moment its Stamina reaches 0. Without this the same death is announced twice and Death Deferred cannot hold.

gmBypassRangeEnforcement.name: Director Bypasses Range Enforcement
gmBypassRangeEnforcement.hint: The Director is never held to an ability’s distance, when targeting, grabbing or forcing movement.

intAnimalsMenu.name: I'm No Threat Animals
intAnimalsMenu.label: Configure Animals
intAnimalsMenu.hint: Edit the animals a Shadow can disguise themselves as in the I'm No Threat panel.

wallBuilderSettings.name: Wall Builder Settings
wallBuilderSettings.label: Configure Wall Builder
wallBuilderSettings.hint: Adjust material costs, damage values, wall restrictions, and wall builder defaults.

rubbleInvisible.name: Rubble is Invisible
rubbleInvisible.hint: When a wall block is broken, the rubble tile becomes invisible. The block remains invisible when fixed. Rubble is still detectable in Wall Builder's Inspect mode.

showWallBuilderButton.name: Show Wall Builder Button
showWallBuilderButton.hint: Show the Wall Builder button in the Walls controls. Director only.

moduleButtonsSettings.name: Module Button Visibility
moduleButtonsSettings.label: Configure Module Buttons
moduleButtonsSettings.hint: Choose which toolbar buttons this module adds to the token controls and wall layer.

toolboxEnabled.name: Group Buttons in Toolbox
toolboxEnabled.hint: Tuck this module’s buttons under a single Combat Toolbox button in the token controls, instead of listing them all.

showForcedMovementButton.name: Show Forced Movement Button
showForcedMovementButton.hint: Show the Forced Movement button in the token controls. Needs Forced Movement turned on.

showGrabButton.name: Show Grab Button
showGrabButton.hint: Show the Grab panel button in the token controls. Needs Conditions and Grab turned on.

showTeleportButton.name: Show Teleport Button
showTeleportButton.hint: Show the Teleport button in the token controls. Needs the Teleport Tool turned on.

showDamageConditionsButton.name: Show Damage & Conditions Button
showDamageConditionsButton.hint: Show the Damage & Conditions button in the token controls. Needs Conditions turned on.

debugMode.name: Debug Mode
debugMode.hint: Print detailed messages to the browser console, for chasing down a problem with the module.

experimentalObstacleArrow.name: Experimental Obstacle Arrow
experimentalObstacleArrow.hint: A discarded arrow design that shaded the parts of a move crossing an obstacle. Kept for reference, and it needs debug mode as well.

cornerCutMode.name: Corner Cut Movement
cornerCutMode.hint: What happens when forced movement cuts the corner of a wall. Collide on Corner Cuts treats it as hitting the wall. Block Corner Cutting refuses the path instead, which is rougher going.

allowCrookedPushPull.name: Wiggly Lines for Push/Pull
allowCrookedPushPull.hint: A push or a pull you draw by hand does not have to travel in a straight line. Strictly against the rules, but it is fun, so it is here.

undoExpirationCheck.name: Undo Expiration Check
undoExpirationCheck.hint: An undo stops working once the creature has moved on from where the move left it.

cancelOnRightClick.name: Cancel Pickers on Right Click
cancelOnRightClick.hint: Right-click on the map to cancel whatever this module is asking you to pick.

targetDistanceLines.name: Distance Lines to Targets
targetDistanceLines.hint: While you have one token selected, a dashed line in your own colour runs to each creature you target, with the distance in squares. Everyone sets their own.

greyscaleNoLos.name: Grey Out What You Cannot See
greyscaleNoLos.hint: While a token is selected, any creature it has no line of effect to is drawn in black and white, the way an unseen combatant is. A quick read of who is actually reachable. Everyone sets their own.

trueDrawSteelLos.name: True Line of Effect
trueDrawSteelLos.hint: Judge targeting by the book’s corner to corner line of effect, and apply the same rule to Foundry’s vision and fog.

loeCornerMode.name: Corner Precision
loeCornerMode.hint: Where the corner to corner lines start and end. Nobody sees through a wall they stand flush against, whichever you pick.

choiceHint.restrictive: Corners sit just inside the square, so a creature at the very edge of what a wall hides still counts as hidden.
choiceHint.normal: The true corners of the square, the geometry the book describes.
choiceHint.generous: Corners sit just outside, so a creature barely leaning past a wall counts as seen.

peekRequiresSpeed.name: Only Offer to Creatures That Can Move
peekRequiresSpeed.hint: A creature with a speed of 0 is never offered the chance to peek, since leaning out of your square is still moving.

peekDistance.name: Peek Distance
peekDistance.hint: How far out of its own square a peeking token leans, as a fraction of one square. Capped below half, because a token more than halfway across would settle into the space it peeked towards rather than back home.

peekDuration.name: Peek Duration (ms)
peekDuration.hint: How long the lean and the settle back take. Slower is funnier.

peekHouseRule.name: Offer to Peek Around Corners
peekHouseRule.hint: When a creature standing against a wall uses a ranged ability or a strike, and leaning out of its square would reach something it cannot reach now, it is offered the chance to peek first.

collisionOnUnitStep.name: Collide on 1-Square Elevation Steps
collisionOnUnitStep.hint: A creature pushed into ground one square higher collides with it instead of climbing up. Steps down are unaffected.

homeRulesSettings.name: Home Rules
homeRulesSettings.label: Configure Home Rules
homeRulesSettings.hint: Optional rule modifications for groups that prefer to run things differently.

homeRulesEnabled.name: Home Rules
homeRulesEnabled.hint: Unlock the house rules below. Each one still has its own switch, and they keep whatever you set them to.

homebrewOptions.name: Homebrew Options
homebrewOptions.hint: Show the settings for third party supplements and homebrew, such as the Null and Shadow options in Ability Automation.

compatibilitySettings.name: Compatibility
compatibilitySettings.label: Configure Compatibility
compatibilitySettings.hint: Settings for compatibility with other installed modules.

stealthSystemEnabled.name: Draw Steel Stealth
stealthSystemEnabled.hint: Adds the Hidden and Concealment the Draw Steel rules have but the Draw Steel system does not, and stops Foundry hiding invisible and burrowing creatures from everyone else entirely.

hiddenMarkers.name: Stealth Markers
hiddenMarkers.hint: Marks every creature a selected token is hidden from: white for cannot see you, yellow for lost sight of you this turn, red for would spot you. Click a red marker to make the reveal official.

revealCombatantPositions.name: Everyone Knows Where Everyone Is
revealCombatantPositions.hint: Draw Steel says every combatant in an encounter knows where the others are, so each one shows through the fog of war as a greyed out stand in. The target pickers still leave out anyone you have no line of effect to.

stealthSneakHouseRule.name: Sneaking in Combat (House Rule)
stealthSneakHouseRule.hint: By the book, any movement during combat ends hiding. Either option lets a hidden creature move at half speed and stay hidden, checking cover or concealment along the whole path or only at each end of it.

choice.ends: Start and end of the move

stealthAutoReveal.name: Reveal Automatically
stealthAutoReveal.hint: Moving, using an ability or being force moved ends hiding by the book, and with this on it simply happens. Off asks instead, with a red spiked eye to click, right click to wave off, or let fade.

stealthTrueHidden.name: Fully Hide Hidden Creatures
stealthTrueHidden.hint: A player stops seeing any creature that is hidden from every token they look through, the way invisible tokens vanish in plain Foundry. The Director always sees everything.

stealthTrueHiddenObjects.name: Fully Hide Hidden Objects
stealthTrueHiddenObjects.hint: A hidden terrain object is not drawn at all for players until somebody finds it with the Search maneuver. On by default, because where a hidden object sits is exactly what the search is for. The Director always sees everything.

stealthRevealPromptSeconds.name: Reveal Prompt Fades After
stealthRevealPromptSeconds.hint: Seconds a red spiked eye stays before it fades away unanswered. Only matters with Reveal Automatically off.

stealthSettings.name: Stealth
stealthSettings.label: Configure Stealth
stealthSettings.hint: Hidden and Concealment, cover, and how burrowing creatures are reached.

from.label: Hide from
from.hint: Every enemy you qualify against, or only the creatures the clicker has targeted.

whileObserved.label: Even while observed
whileObserved.hint: Skips the rule that the creature must not be observing you. Cover alone is then enough.

coverCounts.label: Creatures count as cover
coverCounts.hint: Solid objects normally give cover; this lets creatures stand in for them while hiding.

HideEffect.noToken: No token on the scene for that creature.
HideEffect.notOwner: Only the creature's owner or the Director can hide it.
HideEffect.nobody: {name} has nobody to hide from here.

enhanced.label: Combat Tools Enhanced
enhanced.hint: This comes from the Combat Tools compendium and is kept current on load and when you import over it.

available.label: Enhancement Available
available.hint: The Combat Tools compendium carries an enhanced version of this; Add Enhanced Abilities swaps it in, as does importing it again.

ignored.label: Combat Tools Ignored
ignored.hint: Locked: nothing Combat Tools does will touch this copy, on load or on import.

none.label: No Enhancement
none.hint: Combat Tools has nothing to add to this one.

enhancedBadge.lockHint: Click to lock it against the importer.

automated.label: Combat Tools Automated
automated.hint: This carries Combat Tools effects, so its automation runs here even though the item itself came from somewhere else.

maxGrabs.label: Simultaneous grabs
maxGrabs.description: How many creatures the bearer can keep grabbed at once. The highest of this, the ability’s own count and known traits applies (e.g. Multilimb, Growing Ferocity, Boren).
maxGrabs.values: A whole number, with the Upgrade type.

hideWhileObserved.label: Can hide while observed
hideWhileObserved.description: Hiding no longer needs the enemy to have lost track of you; cover or concealment is enough (e.g. Smoke Bomb, Defensive Roll, Black Ash Teleport).

keepsHidden.label: Abilities do not reveal you
keepsHidden.description: Using an ability while hidden keeps you hidden (e.g. Puppet Strings, Ventriloquist, Sticky Bomb).

moveFreely.label: Movement does not reveal you
moveFreely.description: Any willing move keeps you hidden, whatever the sneaking house rule says. Losing cover or concealment still counts.

moveThroughOccupied.label: Stay hidden through occupied squares
moveThroughOccupied.description: A move whose every square is occupied by another creature does not reveal you (e.g. Raden).

alliesAreCover.label: Allies count as cover
alliesAreCover.description: Your allies stand in for solid objects when hiding and when staying hidden (e.g. Corven, Raden).

creaturesAreCover.label: Any creature counts as cover
creaturesAreCover.description: Every creature stands in for solid objects when hiding and when staying hidden (e.g. One with the Crowd).

staysHiddenAnywhere.label: No cover needed to stay hidden
staysHiddenAnywhere.description: Once hidden, losing cover or concealment does not reveal you (e.g. Camouflage Hunter).

cannotBeHiddenFrom.label: Nobody can hide from this creature
cannotBeHiddenFrom.description: Creatures cannot hide from the bearer, and anyone already hidden from them is spotted. Add the range flag to limit it (e.g. Soulsight, Apex Predator).

cannotHide.label: Cannot hide
cannotHide.description: This creature cannot use the Hide maneuver at all, so it is never offered the option and no enemy can lose track of it (e.g. a creature judged by a Censor with Saint’s Vigilance, a target bleeding from a Carving Dagger).

ignoresConcealmentBane.label: Ignores the concealment bane
ignoresConcealmentBane.description: Strikes by this creature take no bane against a concealed target, so the Concealment pill never appears in its roll window (e.g. Foresight, a target of Fire Up the Night).

observedBy.label: Always observed by whoever applied this
observedBy.description: The creature that applied this effect is always observing the bearer, so the bearer cannot hide from that one creature. Everyone else is unaffected. Only works on an effect applied by an ability, which is what records who applied it (e.g. Apex Predator).

concealmentBaneDoubled.label: Doubles the cover and concealment bane
concealmentBaneDoubled.description: Any bane an ability takes from this creature’s cover or concealment is doubled (e.g. Masking Glamor).

cannotBeHiddenRange.label: Range for nobody can hide
cannotBeHiddenRange.description: Squares within which the flag above applies. Leave it out, or 0, for any distance (e.g. Soulsight uses 2).
cannotBeHiddenRange.values: A whole number of squares, with the Override type.

blocksForEnemies.label: Blocks Line of Effect for Enemies
blocksForEnemies.description: Enemies cannot draw line of effect through this creature, so it shields whatever stands behind it. Allies see past it normally.

rangeCap.label: Line of Effect Range
rangeCap.description: This creature has line of effect only within this many squares. Anything further away cannot be targeted by it.
rangeCap.values: A number of squares, such as 2.

coverGrantsImmunity.label: Cover From This Creature Grants Immunity
coverGrantsImmunity.description: An ally who takes cover behind this creature, and the creature itself, gain damage immunity equal to this creature's highest characteristic score for that hit.

party.showLanguagesHint: The Languages block on the party Overview. Off leaves the skills and characteristics behind, for a table that does not track who speaks what.
party.pickIgnoredHint: Off means a skill or language the Director marked ignored cannot be ticked during advancement. It still shows, struck through, so the player can see it was ruled out rather than wonder where it went.
party.warnHint: Whisper a player when something they already have is marked ignored, on load and whenever the Director changes the marks. An offline player gets it the next time they log in.
party.ignoredWarning: The Director has marked these as ignored, and your character already has them: {names}.
party.noMembers: Add members to the party to see how their skills, languages and characteristics line up.
party.markHint: Click to mark preferred, right click to mark ignored.
party.menuHint: The Overview tab on the party sheet, the hints on skill and language picks, and the nudge to set a party up.
party.enabledHint: Adds an Overview tab to the party sheet tallying skills, languages and characteristics across members and their followers, and marks up skill and language picks during advancement.
party.promptName: Offer to Set the Party Up
party.promptHint: On load, if the party is missing anybody a player has assigned in their User Config, whisper the Director a button that adds them, creating the party first if there is none. It asks once, not again while it is still near the bottom of the log.
party.setupMissing: There is no party actor yet. One is worth having: it is what the Overview tab tallies, and what tells the module who the heroes are.
party.setupEmpty: The party actor has no members yet, so the Overview tab has nothing to tally.
party.setupCreate: Create the party and add every player character
party.setupNoHeroes: No player has a character assigned in their User Config, so there is nobody to add.
party.ignoreDeadHint: Dead languages start marked as ignored on the party Overview, since they're more niche. The Director can still right click to un-ignore them, or left click to make them preferred.

search.doubleEdge: Double edge (opposed roll: +4 instead of a tier)
search.doubleBane: Double bane (opposed roll: -4 instead of a tier)

search.awaitingGM: Roll each hidden creature at your own pace.
search.pingHint: Click to ping. Shift click to pull everyone to it.
search.nobody: Nobody is hidden from {name} within 10 squares with line of effect.
search.notOwner: Only the searcher's owner or the Director can search.

display.hint: Custom label for the chat button. Leave blank to use the auto-generated label.

triggerDamage.title: Triggering Damage
triggerDamage.label: Damage that triggered this
triggerDamage.hint: This ability's damage is worked out from the damage that set it off. Used from the trigger stack the number is filled in for you; used by hand, enter it here.

mover.label: Who Teleports
mover.hint: Self moves the user's own token. Target moves the targeted token instead, asking for one if none is targeted. Only applies to the plain Teleport mode.

mode.label: Mode
mode.hint: Teleport moves the token to a free square in range. Teleswap swaps places with the targeted token. Adjacent teleports next to the targeted token.

spendRecovery.label: Spend a Recovery
spendRecovery.hint: Requires the source or target to spend one recovery.

tempStamina.label: Temporary Stamina
tempStamina.hint: Grant temporary stamina instead of healing. Overrides any existing temporary stamina on the target.

repeatable.label: Repeatable
repeatable.hint: When enabled, the heal button stays active after use. Each use is tracked separately so undo removes exactly what was healed.

Cleanse.noMatch: No matching effects to cleanse on {name}.

expiryFilter.label: Expiry Filter
expiryFilter.hint: Remove effects matching any of these expiry events. Leave empty to ignore expiry when filtering.

statusFilter.label: Status Filter
statusFilter.hint: Remove effects associated with any of these status conditions. Leave empty to ignore status when filtering.

repeatable.label: Repeatable
repeatable.hint: When enabled, the cleanse button stays active after use.

enabled.label: Spend Resource
enabled.hint: When enabled, activating this effect costs the specified amount of heroic resource (or malice for monster abilities). Deducted once per message.

spend.insufficient: {name} does not have enough {resource} to activate this effect (needs {cost}).

displayText.label: Display
displayText.hint: Text shown in the preview line. Use {{potency}} to insert the resolved potency value. Tab when empty to auto-fill: {{potency}} [Effect Name] ([Expiry Event]).

display.label: Button Label
display.hint: Custom label for the chat button. Leave blank to use the effect name.

characteristic.label: Potency Characteristic
characteristic.hint: Characteristic targets roll against for a potency test. Leave blank for no potency test.

custom.label: Custom Value
custom.hint: Enter a number or attribute reference such as @potency.average.

statusId.label: Applied Effect
statusId.hint: Status condition or ability Active Effect to apply to targeted tokens.

end.label: Override End
end.hint: Override the effect's expiry event. Leave blank to use the effect's own setting.

exclusiveSelf.label: Exclusively Include the User
exclusiveSelf.hint: This line belongs to the one using the ability and nobody else. They are listed as a target if they were not already, and the effect appears only on their row.

preApplied.label: Pre-Applied
preApplied.hint: Grant the resource the moment the ability is posted, rather than waiting for the button. It can still be undone.

recipient.label: Goes To
recipient.hint: Who gains the resource. The user is the default, since most gains read "you gain a surge". Targets only works on heroes, who are the only ones with these pools.

enhancedSwap.title: Overwrite With The Enhanced Version?
enhancedSwap.body: Combat Tools carries an enhanced version of the following, and is about to replace what is on the sheet with it. The name, artwork, mechanics and effects are all replaced.
enhancedSwap.note: Anything you have locked is left alone. You can lock a copy from the badge beside its name on its sheet.
enhancedSwap.remember: Do this every time, and stop asking

enhancedAbilities.title: Draw Steel: Combat Tools - Enhanced Abilities
enhancedAbilities.body:
Would you like the Enhanced Abilities added to every actor in this world, and to every actor created from now on?

These are actions the game has but the system does not ship, or actions Combat Tools can automate: Hide and Search bring the scattered stealth rules together, with more to follow. Actors that already have an ability are left alone.

With Don't ask again, your answer stands on every load: Yes keeps every actor current from now on, No never adds anything. Change it later under Keep Enhanced Abilities Current in the module settings.

sampleMacros.title: Draw Steel: Combat Tools - Sample Macros

Would you like to import sample macros for Draw Steel: Combat Tools?

These provide ready-to-use buttons for Forced Movement, Grab, Teleport, and all other module features.

I'm No Threat {name} appears as {target}, their allies may mistake {name} for the real thing.

This illusion covers your entire body, including clothing and armor, and alters your voice to sound like that of the creature. You gain an edge on tests made to convince the creature's allies that you are the creature.

dsTerrain.name: DS Terrain Designer
dsTerrain.hint: Forced movement follows the terrain’s slopes and heights, so a pushed creature lands where it should, and High Ground uses Terrain Designer’s own edges.

tagger.name: Tagger
tagger.hint: The Wall Builder tags walls through Tagger when you have it, and keeps its own tags when you do not.

dsTokenOverride.name: DS Token Override
dsTokenOverride.hint: A squad’s Stamina bar follows Token Override’s Squad Threshold Marks setting, and Token Override’s own health labels are hidden for minions the squad bar already covers.

healthEstimate.name: Health Estimate
healthEstimate.hint: What Health Estimate shows for minions in a squad follows the Minion Health Estimate Display setting.

abilityHud.name: Draw Steel: Ability HUD
abilityHud.hint: The HUD’s triggered action button follows this module for any creature tracking one, green while it is available and orange once it is spent, and everyone at the table sees the same thing. Hide and Search sit with the other basic maneuvers.

dsCombatTracker.name: Draw Steel - Combat Tracker
dsCombatTracker.hint: With Squads Take Their Turn Together on, every minion in a squad shows as able to act during their squad’s turn.

dsMovementLab.name: Draw Steel: Movement Lab
dsMovementLab.hint: Movement Lab leaves the moves this module makes on a creature’s behalf alone, such as forced movement, teleports, and a grabbed creature dragged along.

dsCompanion.name: Draw Steel: Companion
dsCompanion.hint: A companion and their mentor share one triggered action, so spending either spends both.

status.deferDeathDescription: This creature does not die while this is on it. It can sit at 0 Stamina, keeping its token and its place in the order, until the status is removed. A squad minion carrying it is left out of the squad's deaths rather than cancelling one, and only one minion per squad can have it at a time.
